title: Anther culture and molecular marker study on salinity tolerance in rice varieties
author: Nguyen, Phuoc Trong
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Prepare induction medium
steps.instruction: Prepare N6 basal medium supplemented with 2 mg L⁻¹ 2,4‑D and 60 g L⁻¹ sucrose; sterilize the medium before use.

steps.title: Culture anthers on induction medium
steps.instruction: Collect anthers from the three rice hybrids (C53 × Pokkali, C53 × Doc Phung, C53 × D51) and place them onto the prepared N6 + 2 mg L⁻¹ 2,4‑D + 60 g L⁻¹ sucrose medium under sterile conditions.

steps.title: Record induction efficiency
steps.instruction: After the culture period, calculate the percentage of anthers that produced callus for each cross: 20 % for C53 × Pokkali, 10.5 % for C53 × Doc Phung, and 4.5 % for C53 × D51.

steps.title: Regenerate gametoclonal plants
steps.instruction: Transfer the induced calli to MS regeneration medium supplemented with 2 mg L⁻¹ benzyladenine (BA) and 2 mg L⁻¹ kinetin; incubate until plantlets develop.

steps.title: Extract DNA and perform PCR
steps.instruction: From the regenerated plantlets, extract genomic DNA for a total of 72 lines and run PCR assays to detect the presence or absence of salt‑tolerance genes.

steps.title: Identify salt‑tolerant lines
steps.instruction: Analyze PCR results and record the tolerant lines: C53 × Doc Phung‑17, C53 × Doc Phung‑19, C53 × Pokkali‑5, C53 × Pokkali‑11, C53 × Pokkali‑27, C53 × Pokkali‑42, C53 × Pokkali‑43, C53 × Pokkali‑44, C53 × D51‑4, C53 × D51‑5, and C53 × D51‑8.
